title: Rezoning map change for 21-31 46th Avenue, Long Island City
summary: This resolution approves a zoning map amendment changing an M1-4/R6B district to an R7X district with a C2-5 overlay at 21-31 46th Avenue in Long Island City, Queens. The change would allow an 11-story mixed-use building with roughly 84 apartments, including 21 income-restricted units, and ground-floor commercial space. The Council held a public hearing on September 9, 2026 and relies on a Revised Negative Declaration finding no significant environmental impact.
